stem: There is ____ in the director’s most recent film that keeps the melodramatic possibilities latent in its script safely at bay.

Thus, theories and tools developed to study implicit cognition may increase our understanding of the complex interplay between culture and individuals.

Although its director ____ that the movie uses a documentary approach in portraying the famous sit-down strike, in practice its characters are heavily fictionalized and fall into familiar Hollywood types.
